Summary: Meta announced the launch of the Llama 3.1 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) on Tuesday, July 23, comprising pretrained and instruction-tuned text in/text out open source generative AI models in sizes of 8B, 70B, and—for the first time—405B parameters. The 405B parameter model achieves unprecedented parity with leading proprietary, closed source LLMs and supports a 128K context length, offering new capabilities for generative AI applications. The 405B model is available in Amazon Bedrock and is a high-performance option that offers speed and scalability, handling a larger volume of requests and supporting more complex use cases.
